metaTitle: How to Use a Filter Straw Safely
description: Use a filter straw correctly: pick clear water, avoid cross-contamination, keep it from freezing, clear it after use and know when to replace it.
directAnswer: Drink from clear water with the intake submerged, keep the mouthpiece clean, blow the straw out and never use one that froze. Most straws miss viruses and chemicals, so carry a backup method.
